thread:
zara_partners: Quick idea - run a pilot for Nimbus marketplace onboarding: target 3 partners, deliver a forkable repo with 1) a tiny reference arch, 2) opinionated terraform modules, 3) CI + terrascan, 4) signing example, and 5) marketplace metadata. Pilot length = 2 weeks. Thoughts?

leo_eng: love the pilot. suggest we make the modules intentionally constrained: network, storage, runtime. keep outputs minimal (endpoint, health). makes reviews fast.

yun_infra: i'll own CI + validation hooks. plan: PR -> fmt -> terrascan -> init/plan -> optional gated smoke job. also demo local runner for partners behind firewall.

trina_docs: i'll draft partner-facing quickstart and a marketplace-metadata.json example so the portal can auto-populate publisher/display name. also a one-pager on "how to map your VPC".

carlos_partner: from partner side: please include a sample mapping for our IAM roles and an example of how to vendor into internal registries. compliance wants provenance notes too.

leo_eng: we'll add a signing appendix using cosign + short note on KMS-backed keys for production. keep signing optional for pilot but recommended.

zara_partners: timeline idea: week1 = repo scaffold + sample module + CI baseline. week2 = partner integration + feedback loop. demo session at end of week2.

yun_infra: CI snippet we can show in the pilot slides:
```yaml
name: module-validate
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Terrascan
        run: terrascan scan -d . -p policies/
      - name: Terraform Init & Plan
        run: terraform init -input=false && terraform plan -input=false
```

trina_docs: good. i'll include a "common fixes" table (provider mismatches, missing vars, tag policy failures) and a quick troubleshooting checklist.

carlos_partner: small ask: include an example small-synthetic smoke test that does a harmless inference call with a fake prompt so we don't leak customer data.

leo_eng: done. smoke script will use SYNTHETIC_PROMPT and read REDWOOD_API_KEY from env. we'll add a clear note: never commit keys.

zara_partners: partner selection: 1 strategic SI, 1 hardware partner, 1 cloud-native partner. sara_pm please confirm contacts.

publish-bot: Note: marketplace policy update  signed modules show trust badge; unsigned allowed but flagged.

yun_infra: action items: 1) repo scaffold under redwood-partners/nimbus-pilot (due Tue EOD) 2) GH Actions template + terrascan baseline (due Tue EOD) 3) trina draft quickstart + metadata example (due Tue EOD). reconvene Wed to review.

trina_docs: will also add a short CONTRIBUTING.md covering semver and release tagging and a marketplace checklist (contact, security questionnaire, signing intent).

leo_eng: small appendix: hardware tuning hints (fp16 vs int8, default batch size) but marked advanced. don't overload pilot docs.

zara_partners: perfect. i'll send invites and the pilot plan to the partner list. keep comms tight and we'll iterate quickly. :rocket:
